The '''High-Altitude Entry Transport-221''', also known as the '''HAET-221 gunboat''', the '''HAET-221''' or the '''Republic assault gunboat''', was a military [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Gunboat/Legends|gunboat]]/[[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] manufactured by the [[Mekuun Corporation/Legends|Mekuun Corporation]] for use by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone forces]].

==Characteristics==
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]-operated<ref name="HAET DB" /> High-Altitude Entry Transport-221 [[Gunboat/Legends|gunboat]]<ref name="Chronicles" /> was a sleek [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] 17.2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and armed with antipersonnel [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and a larger anti-vehicle [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. Used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the short-range ship was launched from low [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and reached its target destination through the use of powerful positional rockets. Once it entered the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], the craft burned through its high-energy [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding system]] as it deflected reentry [[Temperature/Legends|heat]].<ref name="HAET DB" />

To help it reach its landing site, the ship was equipped with a sophisticated targeting array that quickly mapped a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] topographical features.<ref name="HAET DB" />

Once the vessel entered the lower atmosphere, [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] units were activated, providing the ship with impressive flight capabilities but insufficient thrust to re-achieve orbit. The HAET-221 usually flew at a low altitude of several meters, although it was capable of reaching a height of several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]].<ref name="HAET DB" />

==Role==
[[File:HAET221_2.png|right|thumb|Gunboat on Utapau]]
The Republic assault gunboat's main function was to serve as a ground-level [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] that used its weapons to combat [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|forces]].<ref name="Chronicles" /> However, the ship's mapping system and [[Spotlight/Legends|searchlight]] also allowed it to operate in reconnaissance and search missions, of which the HAET-221 could perform at varying heights.<ref name="HAET DB" />

Its strongest role was tactical air support. During a planetary invasion, [[Low_Altitude_Assault_Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] and [[Low_Altitude_Assault_Transport/carrier/Legends|LAAT/c]] gunships would be exposed to ground fire from static artillery emplacements. Gunboats would dive toward and target these defences with pinpoint accuracy, thus protecting the more vulnerable transports in an escort role.

Being much smaller and more nimble than gunships or shuttles, [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]] could also covertly insert small squads of clones.

==History==
HAET-221s were used as patrol craft during the Republic's [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|battle]] against Confederacy forces on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].<ref name="RotS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:HAETconcept.jpg|left|thumb|Early concept art of the gunboat]]
The HAET-221 was a ship developed for the final film in the [[Prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. The vessel was originally developed as a 1,800 meter long [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] to be used by the Confederacy during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. However, it switched sides to the Republic, becoming known as the GGA support ship, or the "Good Guy A" support ship. It then switched back to the Separatists before switching allegiances one last time, being scaled down, repainted, and modified to become a speeder-sized clone vehicle in the scenes on Utapau.<ref name="HAET DB" />
